meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体自动部署应用到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让 agent 帮你把 Web 应用一键部署到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let agents deploy web apps to Vercel automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want agents to deploy web apps to Vercel with one click

howto.what: 装上本技能后，Claude（NanoClaw agent）能自动安装Vercel CLI、配置API凭证，并用vercel命令部署Web应用到Vercel。它会在需要时引导你提供访问令牌。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude部署Web应用、询问关于Vercel部署，或需要添加Vercel部署能力时触发。系统依次检查安装、配置凭证并完成部署。

say.text: 请帮我部署这个网站到Vercel
say.note: Claude将执行部署流程，可能要求提供API令牌。
Claude将安装Vercel CLI并配置凭证。

say.text: 把当前项目推送到Vercel生产环境

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude (NanoClaw agent) can automatically install the Vercel CLI, configure API credentials, and deploy web applications to Vercel using vercel commands. It will guide you to provide an access token when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to deploy a web app, inquire about Vercel deployment, or request Vercel deploy capability. The system checks installation, configures credentials, and completes deployment in sequence.

say_en.text: Please deploy this site to Vercel.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the deployment flow and may ask for an API token.
Claude will install the Vercel CLI and configure credentials.

say_en.text: Push the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will run vercel deploy command.
